glossary.ja: キング・オブ・ハート
glossary.role: Shuffle Alliance title held by Domon Kasshu (formerly Master Asia).
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Supreme commander of the Zentradi main fleet.
Holy Warrior from a ranching family near Dallas, Texas; resistance pilot (House Givun); pilots Dunbine in ACE2
glossary.personality: Confident, kind and level-headed. A skilled pilot who first meets Sho as an enemy and talks him into questioning Drake. She loves Sho and wishes he would admit his feelings.

glossary.role: Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.role: Protagonist. Heir of the Yaman clan's Kamon dynasty (true name Kamon Myroad), raised on Koam; leads the rebellion against Poseidal. Pilots the L-Gaim, later the L-Gaim Mk-II.
glossary.personality: Calm, earnest and somewhat reserved, hard to read; indecisive at times but prone to sudden outbursts of anger, and reckless whenever his adopted sister Quwasan is involved. Grows into a capable leader.

glossary.note: army/MS rank; a ship's captain (艦長) is also Captain

glossary.role: Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.
